Slovak withholding tax notice

Resident dividends and author income, actual settlements, OZN4311v26 and Annex A.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_sk_base, l10n_cssk_submission_base

What it is for

Prepare a complete monthly resident withholding notice from the company's existing accounting and actual payment evidence. The module does not book a second dividend, author expense, payment or tax. It uses the shared statutory export, retained filing and receipt workflow.

Common case

  1. Select the company/month, actual preparation/filing dates, preparer and withholding account 342. Confirm that no other resident withholding titles are missing: row 01 must include all resident withholding for the month.
  2. Add the dividend recipient, completed profit period, actual decision and payment dates, gross amount and source references. Select the posted income, payment and withholding lines. Review the actual payment evidence.
  3. Allocate the separate actual tax transfer: its 342 debit, amount, actual date and evidence. A posting or transfer request does not prove payment.
  4. Review sources, then Export XML against the original pinned XSD. Record the external filing and retain its receipt through shared delivery tracking. This records an external action; it does not transmit or prove acceptance.

The existing Statutory submissions: prepare role gives an ordinary accountant receipt access without system or accounting-manager rights. An unfiled preview can be reset. Reopening filed history retains the shared manager gate.

Sources and payment forms

Use dividend liability 364, author liability 321/379 and withholding/remittance 342, including valid analytics. Actual dates can differ from bookkeeping dates. Reversed sources and reversal entries are refused. All live notices reserve their source amounts across months; a full correction replaces its predecessor without creating another payment. A working correction cannot release the still-filed allocation for an unrelated notice. Concurrent source changes retry.

Bank/cash payments and native account.payment through its outstanding account are supported. A registered payment still needs reviewed actual-payment evidence; a generic current-asset credit is insufficient. Select Set-off for income paid by mutual claims: retain the legal set-off evidence and reconcile the recipient's actual receivable. Tax remittances have their own bank or documented authority-allocation source. The source snapshot retains the actual settlement credits and native payment/claim references. A combined entry with gross liability, withholding and net payment is supported; the same physical credits cannot prove more reported payments than they actually settle.

The independent FS example checks 650 + 1,050 = 1,700. Dividend rates follow the start of the profit period: 10% for 2024 and 7% for other supported periods. Resident author income without an advance written waiver uses 19%. A section 43(14) waiver is reported through its separate agreement notice, not a fictitious zero withholding here.

For author income, Taxable income means income excluding VAT less an art-fund contribution only if that contribution was actually withheld, as required by section 43(5)(b). Keep the original remuneration, any actual contribution and their ledger evidence. Do not subtract an assumed contribution. The author's payment then equals this taxable income less withholding tax.

Posted reversals currently exclude an original source, including a partially credited supplier bill. For example, a bill of 1,500 with a linked credit note of 150 cannot yet provide the remaining 1,350 through this adapter. This is a known unsupported case; do not remove the native credit-note link or alter posted accounting merely to bypass it. Retained exports remain available.

Filing, deadlines and corrections

Only remittances through the actual filing cutoff are included. Multiple dates remain individually retained. Annex A prints one remittance date per income; the accountant reviews that presentation from the actual dates.

Regular filing warns after the following month's 15th, shifted for days of rest. The September 2026 exception and Easter are respected. A different date granted by the authority under section 43(11) requires its actual retained decision.

The exact exported XML and payload are the filing record. Later changes to the ledger or recipient's address warn about a possible separate correction; they do not block recording the external filing. Allocation consumption is rechecked. Later working drafts do not displace an already exported allocation when its actual filing is recorded. Creating another export still checks all working reservations, as well as retained claims from other notices. Create correction copies the complete income set and retains the predecessor. Confirm its actual filing date against a receipt, not a planned cutoff or the time Odoo recorded it. Filed ownership and correction identity survive reset.

Identity and scope

Formal Slovak birth-number checks cover length, embedded date, payment boundary and mod11. Nine digits refer to a birth before 1954; the two-digit year alone does not imply 2000. Formal validity does not prove assignment. An identifier inconsistent with section 2 of 301/1995 requires authority verification under section 7; do not invent a replacement. Date of birth is used only when no Slovak birth number is assigned.

Supported: a Slovak corporate EUR payer, resident individual dividends from profit periods starting in 2017 or later and resident author income without a waiver. Other resident withholding titles require a complete notice outside this adapter; the scope confirmation prevents silently omitting them. Foreign recipients/Annex B, legal-person recipients and pre-2017 dividend health regimes are outside this adapter. OZN4311v26 does not certify a future form vintage. The official form and original schema bytes are pinned in data/SCHEMA_VERSION. Signature and transport are separate integrations.
